verdicts.reason: A is just the portrait original shrunk into the middle of the landscape canvas, with huge empty white side bands. It wasn't rearranged at all, and the logo and address text are tiny, but the hierarchy and grouping are intact. B does try a banner layout, but the reading order is broken: the 'EXHIBITION' kicker has dropped below the address. The date block floats off-axis to the right of the headline's left edge, the logo has shrunk to an illegible speck, and the image is cropped so hard that the concrete block motif is lost. The big empty right side makes it lopsided.
